_doc: Legacy unported Warrior skills; Power Strike and Slash Blast moved to hero.json in #301. First job (book 100, job 100): Power Strike, Slash Blast, Iron Body and the passives Improved HP Recovery and Improved MaxHP Increase (spec #151 ticket #163; the owner dropped Endure 1000002 after the spec, so it has no entry, cards or sound). Second job (spec #165, appended after the first-job entries, rows by skill id): Fighter 110, Page 120 and Spearman 130 each have two Masteries, two Final Attacks and two Boosters (#181; keys sword_mastery_fighter ... polearm_booster, each listing its weapon_families), plus Rage and Power Guard (Fighter, #182), Power Guard and Threaten (Page, #182 #183) and Iron Will and Hyper Body (Spearman, #184); a second job has no attack skill of its own, the Final Attack is its attack skill (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md 7.9-7.12). Entry format and tier rules: see ../skills.json _doc. New keys here: action "weapon" (the cast stance is the held weapon's first basic-attack stance, WeaponInfo.skill_action, so a spear stabs and a polearm swings; tier C: the WZ nodes have no action); cast rules weapon_reach (the nearest mob inside the held weapon's swing envelope, WeaponReach.envelope; tier A reach, the same as the basic attack) and range_around (up to mobCount mobs whose body centre is within the canonical level's `range` px of the player; tier A numbers); regen {pool, field} (Loadout.regen_bonus reads the canonical level field instead of a level formula). hpCon is read from the canonical level as hp_cost. Prerequisites in the WZ req nodes are ignored (tier C owner choice #31). cooldown and action_time are tier C (ours).

iron_body.name: Iron Body
iron_body._buff: Tier A: canonical pdd, time, mpCon, the alert2 action and sound; the node has no effect art. Tier C: self-only auto-cast while inactive and affordable, recast on expiry; canonical effects snapshot until expiry; 0.8 s cast hold.

improved_hp_recovery.name: Improved HP Recovery
improved_hp_recovery.desc: Recovers additional HP with every regeneration pulse.
improved_hp_recovery._regen: Tier A: canonical hp per level (3 to 50) added to each regeneration pulse. Tier C: v83 applies it only while standing still; here HP regeneration always runs (balance.json regen), so the bonus does too.

improved_max_hp.name: Improved MaxHP Increase
improved_max_hp.desc: Increases the Max HP gained at each level-up.

text.desc: Boosts the Max HP you gain at each level-up.
text.h: Each level-up gives +{x} more Max HP

improved_max_hp._passive: Tier B: Cosmic adds the canonical x (4 to 40) to the Max HP of each level-up at the skill's level then; never retroactive. The AP half of the skill (y per HP AP) has no meaning here (AP is automatic).

rage.name: Rage
rage.desc: Raises your weapon attack, at the cost of weapon defence.

text.desc: Raises your weapon attack and lowers your weapon defence for a while.

rage._buff: Tier A: canonical pad (W.Att +3 to +12), pdd (already negative in the WZ: -3 to -12, so it is taken as is, never scaled), time (46 to 160 s), mpCon, the alert2 action, effect art and sound. The WZ node is a party buff; here it affects you only (tier C). Tier C: any held weapon, auto-cast while inactive and affordable, recast on expiry; canonical effects snapshot until expiry; 0.8 s cast hold. The WZ affected art (the party members' side) is not used.

power_guard_fighter.name: Power Guard
power_guard_fighter.desc: Returns part of the touch damage you take to the monster that touched you.

text.desc: While it lasts, part of the damage a monster deals by touching you is returned to it and taken off the damage you receive. Half the rate against bosses, and never more than 10% of the monster's Max HP at once. Attacks and projectiles are not returned.

power_guard_fighter._buff: Tier A: canonical x (11 to 40 %), time (3 to 90 s), mpCon, the alert2 action, effect art and sound. Tier B (third-party v83 reimplementation): only monster contact damage is returned, half the rate against a boss, at most 10% of that monster's Max HP (the cap exists only in the String desc, not as a WZ field), and the same amount comes off the damage taken. Tier C: amounts are floored; the returned damage is the character's own, so it shows a damage number and a kill gives EXP and drops as usual; it does not trigger Final Attack or on-hit statuses. Auto-cast while inactive and affordable, recast on expiry; effects snapshot until expiry; 0.8 s cast hold. RunWorld.take_hit applies it after weapon-damage reduction and before Magic Guard's split.

threaten.name: Threaten
threaten.desc: Threatens up to six monsters around you, lowering their weapon attack and weapon defence for a while.

text.desc: Threaten the monsters around you, lowering their weapon attack and weapon defence.
text.h: Enemy weapon attack {x}, weapon def. {y} for {time} sec., up to {mob_count|monster|monsters}

threaten._cast: Tier A: canonical x (weapon attack change) and y (weapon defence change), both negative and flat, time, mpCon, mobCount 6, lt/rb, the alert2 action, effect art, mob overlay and sound; the node has no prop, so every target takes it (no success roll, no RNG). Tier C: auto-cast through the crowd rule (cast.status threatened) at three eligible mobs that are not threatened yet, 1 s cooldown, nearest targets first; bosses and kinds that resist statuses never take it; it refreshes without stacking and coexists with slow, poison and freeze; mob weapon attack (contact and attack stances) and weapon defence floor at 0, magic attack and magic defence are untouched.

power_guard_page.name: Power Guard
power_guard_page.desc: Returns part of the touch damage you take to the monster that touched you.

text.desc: While it lasts, part of the damage a monster deals by touching you is returned to it and taken off the damage you receive. Half the rate against bosses, and never more than 10% of the monster's Max HP at once. Attacks and projectiles are not returned.

power_guard_page._buff: The Page's Power Guard: the same numbers and rules as power_guard_fighter (the WZ level tables are identical; its Sound.wz node is a UOL to 1101007, so the sound path names the target). Both keys feed the one power_guard stat; branch exclusivity means a run owns only one.

iron_will.name: Iron Will
iron_will.desc: Temporarily increases your weapon and magic defence.

text.desc: Temporarily increases your weapon and magic defence.
text.h: Weapon def. +{pdd}, magic def. +{mdd} for {time} sec.

iron_will._buff: Tier A: canonical pdd and mdd (1 to 20), time (15 to 300 s), mpCon, the alert2 action, effect art and sound. Tier C: the WZ skill is a party buff; here it is self only, auto-cast while inactive and affordable, recast on expiry; canonical effects snapshot until expiry; 0.8 s cast hold. Both defences go through the shared pdd/mdd buff consumers (RunWorld.hit_defense).

hyper_body.name: Hyper Body
hyper_body._buff: Tier A: canonical x (Max HP %) 2 to 60, time (10 to 300 s), the alert2 action, effect art and sound; its y (Max MP %) and mpCon are unused (no MP, ADR 0006). Tier C: the WZ skill is a party buff; here it is self only, auto-cast while inactive, recast on expiry; canonical effects snapshot until expiry; 0.8 s cast hold. Tier B (v83): the percentage applies to the whole maximum (base, level growth, passives and worn equipment); current HP is unchanged at cast, and when it ends HP above the normal maximum drops to it. It is a buff stat of its own (max_hp_pct).
